store_info.name: Trail & Summit Gear
store_info.description: We are a small outdoor gear store based in Nairobi, Kenya, specializing in hiking and camping equipment for  weekend adventurers. Our mission is to provide high-quality gear for outdoor enthusiasts and adventurers. We are committed to sustainability and supporting local communities through our business practices.
